detail.png|left|120px]] }} '''Mithril arrows''' are [[arrows]] made of [[mithril bar|mithril]], are stackable, and can be used with any standard [[bow]] of [[willow bow|willow]] or stronger. Stronger than [[steel arrow]]s, mithril arrows can be made at level 45 [[Fletching]] by using [[mithril arrowtips]] on [[headless arrow]]s. Doing so grants 112.5 [[experience]] for every batch of 15 arrows made. As with most [[Arrow|arrows]], they can be [[Poison#Weapon poisoning|poisoned]]. Mithril arrows can be purchased from [[Lowe's Archery Emporium]] in [[Varrock]], or [[Brian's Archery Supplies]] in [[Rimmington]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |version1 = Unpoisoned |version2
